feeds.title: Expat Network
feeds.description: Expat Network has become the leading UK-based organisation for expats seeking work and assistance overseas. Find the latest expat jobs, news and resources here: money, tax, relocation, healthcare, property.

feeds.title: Expat Child
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Carole Hallett Mobbs. In 2006, when our daughter had just turned five years old, we left Britain to start our expat life.This blog covers information and advice for parents of expat children. We're not just for new expats either. Your Expat Child grows & evolves, just like us.

feeds.title: Albom Adventures
feeds.description: Living in New Zealand and travelling the world, expat Rhonda Albom takes you on a vicarious adventure as she captures the essence of travel through photography, stories, tips, and humour. She inspires young baby boomers to travel New Zealand and the world.

feeds.title: Sydney Moving Guide - Written By Expats, For Expats. Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Lauren and Sydney Moving Guide is my blog. I LOVE being an expat in Sydney but am fed up with all the misinformed and useless expat guides, not only giving bad advice to those making the move to Sydney, but also charging for it! So I created Sydney Moving Guide, written by expats for expats.

feeds.title: Where Can I Live
feeds.description: Plan your relocation abroad. Information on visas and permits and pathways to citizenship. Hear from Expats around the world.

feeds.title: The Thailand Life
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Peter. I've been living & traveling in Thailand for 12 years. I'm here to give you all the information you need to make your Thai adventure safe, happy, & successful.

feeds.title: Bright Tax Blog
feeds.description: Americans abroad are required to file US taxes, reporting their worldwide income. The Bright Tax blog is a world-class resource for expats. With clients in over 190 countries worldwide, multiple award-winning Bright!Tax is the leading online US Expat Tax Services provider for the 9 million Americans who live abroad.

feeds.title: Migrating Miss
feeds.description: Travel & Lifestyle Blogger finding her feet in Scotland after living and working around the world. Keep up with adventures about living abroad and expat life from a serial migrator. Six homes down and counting.

feeds.title: endless distances
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Sarah. Welcome to Endless Distances, where I write about how I try to make daily life an adventure. On this blog find about my travel, fitness, expat life and much more.

feeds.title: Tripsget - Travel & Expat Blog
feeds.description: Tripsget is a blog for young adventurous professionals and expats. We both work full-time and enjoy exploring the world during our vacations. Our aim here is to inspire you to travel more and help you organise your vacations in such way, so you manage to see as much as possible within a limited amount of time.

feeds.title: Piccavey
feeds.description: Molly began writing about Spain in 2011. Based in Andalusia. Molly is passionate about the Mediterranean lifestyle, historic sites, and Spanish food. Living like a local in Spain since 1998, she is fluent in Spanish. Molly enjoys sharing her travel tips and recommendations on this blog.

feeds.title: Rachel's Ruminations Blog
feeds.description: Practical information about travel to historical and cultural sites for independent, inquisitive travelers who love history, written by a middle-aged travel fanatic. Rachel's Ruminations is a travel blog focusing primarily on independent travel to historical and cultural destinations.

feeds.title: A Wanderlust for Life - Expat & European Travel Blog
feeds.description: We Sean and Jessica, a couple who craved the European lifestyle, so we sold everything and moved to Amsterdam to be able to travel around Europe. We share stories and tips about expat life and travel while encouraging fellow European expats to get out and explore even if just for the weekend.

feeds.title: In Nica Now
feeds.description: We're Gordon and Elisha a semi-retired Canadian couple who has been living and loving life in Nicaragua since December 2011. Currently we reside on Pacific coast in the colourful beach town San Juan del Sur. Together we created this blog so we could share our Nicaraguan expat experience with you.

feeds.title: The British Berliner Blog
feeds.description: The British Berliner is a lifestyle expat travel blog about culture, history, travels around the world, Europe, and being British in Berlin. It will focus on a British girl from Manchester living in Berlin, her promotion of British-German life, culture, history, literature, theatre, style, Europe, travels around the world, what she does in normal everyday life and where she goes.

feeds.title: Eternal Expat - An Expat in Mexico City
feeds.description: Hi I'm Laura Bronner, AKA the Eternal Expat. In the last seven years I've lived in Switzerland, New Zealand, Australia, South Korea, England, and now - Mexico. I want to show you that a life of travel doesn't require a ton of money or all that much bravery. I've been doing it for all this time without either of them.

feeds.title: Expat Life with Chickenruby
feeds.description: Expat life, family and travel with teens and a cat and a dog. UK to South Africa to Dubai.

feeds.title: California Globetrotter
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Lorelei, I'm an expat living in Germany obsessed with adorable fairy tale towns, and castles. California Globetrotter's goal is to provide you, with useful tips and information for traveling Europe, also I will share here my expat opinions and experiences of living among the Germans.

feeds.title: Latitude Adjustment Two Wanderers in Panama and Beyond
feeds.description: Our decision to move to Panama was in the works for many years. Now that it has come to fruition, this blog is our way of sharing our experience as world travelers and expats in Panama. Our hope is that you too will be inspired to jump out of your comfort zone and find the thing that floats your boat and perhaps even plan an escape of your own!

feeds.title: COLOURFULWORLD
feeds.description: HI, I am Sami, Portuguese, born in Mozambique, I have also lived in South Africa,Germany, Portugal and now living in Australia. I love crafts, painting, reading and travel. I blog about anything that I find interesting from our travels, to recipes, cats, crafts, decor and ofcourse expat life.

feeds.title: Gail at Large Blog
feeds.description: I'm a Canadian who moved to Porto, in the north of Portugal, in late 2013. Previously in Toronto and Vancouver, with expat stops in the USA, Scotland, and Australia. A freelance photographer since 2008, and an avid blogger posting daily since 2002.

feeds.title: Arabian Notes
feeds.description: Arabian Notes is a blog by lindsey parry who writes about life as an expat in Abu Dhabi, answering questions people might have about living in or visiting the capital, sharing her favourite aspects of the city and things to do, thoughts on life and culture and more.

feeds.title: Dutch Dutch Goose - A Expat Lifestyle &Travel Blog
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Elizabeth, a type-A travel lover and freelance writer. Along with my three energetic little boys and loving husband, we are exploring Europe in search of amazing experiences. Best of all, I get to share our adventures and top finds with you!

feeds.title: Truly Expat
feeds.description: The world is too big to leave unexplored. Truly Expat The world is too big to leave unexplored Recent Blog Post My story of travelling through the world.

feeds.title: My Slice of Mexico
feeds.description: Discover and re-discover Mexico's cuisine, culture, and history through the recipes, backyard stories, and other interesting findings of an expatriate in Canada.

feeds.title: Proudly South African In Perth
feeds.description: Want to know all about migrating to Perth? Want to see what this awesome city has to offer? Follow Proudly South African In Perth for helpful tips and advice about migration to Australia as well as what's on in Perth and around Western Australia. We'll share events, places to visit, wonderful local businesses, things to see and do and anything and everything related to being South African in Perth.

feeds.title: Expats living in Rome Blog
feeds.description: Expats living in Rome an International Social Network run by expatriates living and working in Rome. Our goal is to help one another and make life a little easier while making Rome our Home. Surround yourself with people who are motivated or already living in Rome, who may be able to provide you some helpful tips.

feeds.title: Moving with Mitchell
feeds.description: Jerry and I get around. In 2011, we moved from the USA to Spain. We now live near Malaga. A bilingual blog sharing stories of a life lived across the United States and Andalusia. Love, laughter, relationships, and disasters.

feeds.title: TenguLife
feeds.description: The Curious Guide to Japan is about life on the ground through the eyes of an expat who came to Tokyo for two years and stayed for twenty-five!

feeds.title: The Expat Flyer
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Patrick. I grew up an expat kid. I want to help other expats like me, living in the UAE, to make the most of the opportunities to earn and spend their miles and points.

feeds.title: Beyond Prague
feeds.description: The purpose of this blog is to show a wider picture of the Czech Republic than just the capital city. Prague is a lovely city that I encourage people to visit, but there is just so much more this small country has on offer to the visitor and expat alike that it would be a shame if you didn't venture past the confines of Prague itself.

feeds.title: Sand In My Curls
feeds.description: Who am I? It's such a vague, yet deep, question. But let's be honest, no one really wants to read about my inner workings, that's what my blog is for, so instead, I threw together some crazy, stupid and cool facts to give you a sense of that answer. Here is where all of my madness comes from...

feeds.title: Expat Panda
feeds.description: Expat Panda is where I share the journey of my life as a 20 something, married, South African expat living in the Middle East. I began Expat Panda because I wanted to keep and share a record of my life and encourage other teachers to travel. So you can expect all sorts of tips for what it's really like to live in the Gulf.

feeds.title: Repatriate Games
feeds.description: Ours began as the classic ex-pat story in 2012. Darling husband got an overseas post; I went from being a Working Spouse to becoming a Trailing Spouse.

feeds.title: adventurings - expat tales from urban bohemia
feeds.description: Welcome to Adventurings - A travel blog by Cynthia, an American expat living in South Bohemia, Czech Republic. On this blog, i write about this adventure as an american expat and all of the travels that have fortunately come along with it.

feeds.title: Our House in Provence
feeds.description: We have a beautiful stone village house located in the heart of the medieval village of Sablet in Vaucluse region of Provence France. Dating from the 17th century, the house was beautifully renovated by an English lady with all of the comforts of a modern home while retaining its authentic Provençal character and charm. On this blog, we share experiences from our visits along with those of our families and friends to Sablet and the South of France.

feeds.title: Kathi Daniela
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kathi, a 30-year-old expat, journalist and traveler. This is my own little space on the internet, KATHI DANIELA. Welcome! I started this blog in 2016, when I moved to South Africa. In the following years, KATHI DANIELA developed into a blogzine about life abroad, the struggles of being an expat, international relationships, my travels, and some ramblings and lifestyle topics. I hope you enjoy the read!

feeds.title: Divine Hours Blog
feeds.description: Divine Hours Blog is written by an American expat living in Australia. The blog covers a range of topics related to expat life, such as culture shock, making friends, and dealing with homesickness. The author also shares her experiences of traveling around Australia.

feeds.title: Correr Es Mi Destino
feeds.description: Stories from a French woman who moved to English Canada, with immigration tips, photos, Canadian culture, politics and travels. Juliette Giannesini is a traveler, translator, writer and photographer.

feeds.title: Expatclic - The platform for all Expatwomen
feeds.description: We are a non-profit organization that helps expat women all over the world before, during and after their relocations. We promote respect and interest amongst different cultures, mutual support, online communication and positive sharing.

feeds.title: Adventures Around Asia Blog
feeds.description: My name is Richelle and I've been living in China and traveling around Asia for the last four years. Expat, traveler, and spicy food lover, I've spent the last few years living in China and traveling around Asia. In my spare time I enjoy salsa dancing, scuba diving and stuffing my face with street food.

feeds.title: International Citizens Blog
feeds.description: International Citizens is a reliable source for expatriates and travelers from all around the world. To help you as you're traveling or living abroad we have developed a range of resources to assist you in a number of ways.

feeds.title: My Life in Germany
feeds.description: Hi, I am Sindy. This blog is all about how I moved to Germany. Here I share my experiences along with important tips and tricks concerning studying and working, for Expats who live in Germany. Also, get information on finance, culture, food, life in Germany, and more.

feeds.title: Lauren on Location
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lauren! I'm a 24-year-old expat living with a wicked case of wanderlust. Here on my blog, you'll find everything from travel advice, destination guides, and a ridiculous love for food, to amateur photos, international shopping tips and other random musings.

feeds.title: Glitter Rebel
feeds.description: Hi, we are Josh and Lieze. We decided that life was too short to just sit around, & packed our stuff for Dubai. Josh and I met online and only a few months later I moved from Antwerp to Josh in London. Although living in London was great, the high costs, the massive rat-race and the political climate meant we felt uneasy and were ready to tackle an adventure abroad head-on. Ever since we moved abroad we have travelled non-stop, combining history, magical panoramas, secret temples & the best local food. Becoming expats was the best decision we ever made.

feeds.title: Venga, Vale, Vamos
feeds.description: I'm Kirstie Jeffries, a Californian expat, digital marketer, and travel addict. I've lived in Spain as an auxiliar de conversación and then worked in Australia on a working holiday turned 457 visa, before taking off on my current journey around the world!

feeds.title: GoExpat
feeds.description: Welcome to the blogs & articles section at GoExpat. You will find here resources and advice for those moving overseas and living currently by local expatriates.

feeds.title: Two Expats Mexico
feeds.description: I'm Paul and I write all of the posts on this site. Linda, my wonderful wife of over 16 years, does all of the editing. We got rid of 99% of our belongings and started a new life in Mexico. We now write articles about living in Mexico. Everything you need to know about moving to Mexico.

feeds.title: Lost in Silver Fern
feeds.description: Find tips for moving to New Zealand, advice about visas, insights into the city and tips for things to see and do, from Josie McCrickard, a Yorkshire gal in Wellington.

feeds.title: The Accidental Australian
feeds.description: The Accidental Australian is a blog by an American expat who moved to Australia on a whim and fell in love with the country. The blog covers a range of topics related to expat life in Australia, from navigating the healthcare system to exploring the country's stunning natural beauty. With a mix of personal stories and practical advice, The Accidental Australian is a great resource for anyone considering a move down under.

feeds.title: Expats Ecuador
feeds.description: Michelle (Ecuadorian) and Jason (Australian) share a fulfilling life together in Ecuador. They've created this site to provide Ecuador travel tips and help other expats make the transition to life in Ecuador. Michelle is a former tour guide with an abundance of knowledge on all things Ecuador. Jason is a seasoned digital nomad, turned expat, who fell in love with Ecuador and never left.

feeds.title: Flavors of Bogota
feeds.description: Flavors of Bogota is the creation of Karen Attman and Peter Corredor, two people who are in love with food and the growing restaurant scene in Bogota. Karen left her hometown of Philadelphia to pursue expat life, and she's still loving it.

feeds.title: London New Girl
feeds.description: Your guide for moving to and living in London. Kamila shares all her research and thoughts, to help others who are thinking about doing the same. Get practical advice, travel stories and tips.

feeds.title: The Millennial Abroad
feeds.description: I'm a 20-something millennial committed to living life on my terms. This blog is for anyone curious about living abroad as an American ex-pat, living in France and finding work, traveling to new places, living abroad for extended periods of time, making the choice to move abroad, and seeking excitement and challenge in their life.

feeds.title: Surviving in Italy
feeds.description: Hi, I am Elizabeth. An American Expat In Italy. This is a travel story, an honest account of my adventures, the happy moments, the spilled wine, missed flights, cultural misunderstandings and everything in between.

feeds.title: The Travelling Squirrel
feeds.description: Originally from Milan, and currently living in Nice, I have been caught by the travel bug when I was 18 and since then I never stopped exploring this beautiful world and I keep collecting wonderful travel memories.

feeds.title: My Little Expat Kitchen
feeds.description: I'm Magdalini. I am from Greece, born and bred in Athens, and for the last eight years I have been living in The Hague, Netherlands with my also Greek boyfriend, S. I share recipes and stories about Greek food with the world. The recipes featured on her blog range from traditional Greek recipes (naturally), to modern international ones.

feeds.title: Little Island Takara
feeds.description: I'm Laura, a 20 something military wife and expat living in Okinawa, Japan! I'm an island girl, a cafe lover and a wanderluster at heart. Little Island Takara is where I document our adventures in Okinawa, our travels, and all the beautiful places in between.

feeds.title: ADELANTE
feeds.description: A travel and lifestyle blog of an American expat living in Madrid, traveling, photographing, and eating gluten-free through Spain and Europe.

feeds.title: EEE Award Blog
feeds.description: Expat education is tricky! How do you know if you are choosing the right school for your child? EEE Assessments can help you make an informed decision.

feeds.title: Adventitious Violet
feeds.description: This is a cultural blog for travellers, expats and creatives. This is the right place for you if you love to travel, if you like a nice adventure and if you love good books and good food.

feeds.title: The Copenhagen Tales - an expat lifestyle blog
feeds.description: Hej, I'm Laura, a German expat living and blogging in Copenhagen, Denmark. An expat lifestyle blog in Copenhagen, focusing on great food, exciting experiences, and a stylish life in the Danish capital!

feeds.title: Tex Mex Expats Blog
feeds.description: The adventures of Gary & Elizabeth. We left our home in Austin, TX, in April of 2017, and are now living in Puerto Morelos, Quintana Roo, Mexico. It's us, our two dogs Bessie and Sadie, and our cat, Wookie.

feeds.title: Making Here Home
feeds.description: British Mum of 2, founder of The Expat Book Club. I write about family life on the move. From the UK to Bangkok to Germany and who knows where next...

feeds.title: Take Me To Australia
feeds.description: We moved to Australia and discovered an amazing new life. Now we're inspiring others to move or travel to this epic country.

feeds.title: And Then We Moved To … Blog
feeds.description: This is a blog about expat life, raising multilingual and multicultural children, and travel. I write about life as an expat, the feeling of having several different 'homes' scattered around the world, trying to raise multilingual children in my cross-cultural, East-meets-West marriage, and of course traveling the world. Blog by Mariam Navaid Ottimofiore.

feeds.title: Living The Turkish Dream
feeds.description: I am Danni. While on tour, I met a Turkish guy and I moved to Turkey to be with him. I figured a blog would be the perfect place for me to discuss things I'm passionate about and give people an insight into what life is really like living in a foreign country far away from family, friends, and everything I've ever known.

feeds.title: Oddities and Ends
feeds.description: My name is Jessie, and I'm a 35-year-old American living in Wolfsburg, Germany with my husband. This blog originally started out as a place for me to share my opinions and occasionally post short stories. Now, it has evolved into a travel and expat/immigrant experience blog. Here, you will find posts on how life in Germany is awesome, embarrassing stories from my failed attempts to communicate with the natives, and travel stories.

feeds.title: Karen Moves to Mexico Blog
feeds.description: I am a Canadian expat woman a mom and wife and Non Profit Executive who is living a new adventure in Mexico. This is my story of what it's like to make the craziest move of my life and the daily adventure of working in an orphanage in small town Mexico.

feeds.title: Clara Wiggins - Expat Partner's Survival Guide
feeds.description: From how to organise an overseas move to what to do in the event of an earthquake, the Expat Partner's Survival Guide is a light-hearted yet in-depth guide for anyone accompanying their partner on an overseas assignment.

feeds.title: A Life Shift
feeds.description: I'm Alison, a Canadian interior designer living and working in Hong Kong with my husband, three and a half year old son and new baby girl. I started this blog in 2015 after we had accepted an opportunity to move from Vancouver to Hong Kong. Embracing a life of change and adventure as newlyweds felt exciting and challenging at the same time.

feeds.title: A Brit Abroad
feeds.description: I'm a veteran Brit expat living the life in Sunny California. I've been here for about 20 years now and yes, I can be a bit gobby. These are my observations, comments and sometimes rants about the differences between my home and my adopted home.

feeds.title: Bordeaux Expats
feeds.description: A blog about Expats living in Bordeaux, France. English speaking community. Useful information about the city of Bordeaux and the surrounding area.

feeds.title: Planes Trains and Shanes
feeds.description: Laura and Jordan made the move to France two weeks before the entire country went into lockdown due to COVID-19. They spent three months living out of suitcases with clothes packed with the wrong season in an AirBnB. After being allowed outside for only one hour a day, they have embraced their newfound freedom and are taking advantage of every moment to explore as much as Europe as they can while living abroad. You can find them on the weekends taking planes, trains, or the COVID friendly way (in a car) to new places.

feeds.title: Joburg Expat
feeds.description: A blog about the tales of an American mother of four in Johannesburg, and the top source of relocation advice for expats moving to South Africa.

feeds.title: Ersatz Expat
feeds.description: I was born in the Netherlands to a Dutch/Irish Family. Since then I have lived in Norway, Nigeria, Turkey and Venezuela. Our current home is in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. This blog is about how we muddle through daily life as expats and how things have changed from the adventures of my childhood.

feeds.title: Geneva family diaries Blog
feeds.description: Geneva family diaries is a blog and website for expat families living in the Geneva region. Read about our adventures, share tips and advice on topnotch things to do, places to go and the best baby-friendly restaurants in town.

feeds.title: Expat With A Cat
feeds.description: Adventures of an American Mom Living in Germany

feeds.title: Living in Frankfurt - Frankfurt's most popular Expat blog
feeds.description: I am originally from the UK and have been living in Frankfurt since 2013. I am sure that you will also notice that the official information from the authorities are mainly in German and can often be more confusing than helpful. Which is why I started to write this blog. The aim is to catalogue my experiences and knowledge in Frankfurt and surrounding areas.

feeds.title: Ciao Amalfi Blog
feeds.description: Ciao! I'm Laura, a writer, photographer, art historian and social media marketing manager. The road to expat life in Italy for me was as twisty as the Amalfi Coast road; and I'm passionate about sharing an insider view of my home to help travelers discover and enjoy the most beautiful experiences on the Amalfi Coast.

feeds.title: Blue Abaya
feeds.description: The Blue Abaya website was founded by a Finnish travel blogger Laura Alho in 2010. Blue Abaya started as a personal blog describing expat life and Laura's travels and adventures in the 'Magic Kingdom' of Saudi Arabia.

feeds.title: ThePackMama
feeds.description: We are the Hollis Family. Your ordinary, animal-obsessed, travel-loving family presented with a life-changing opportunity to emBARK on a three-year, 4,623 mile away, once-in-a-lifetime adventure to Gmunden, Austria. ThePackMama.co is a manifestation of our expat journey and all the planning it took to get here. We share weekly recap videos and travel tips for those wishing to follow in our footsteps. Whether you are a pet parent seeking out information on how to travel abroad, or a travel enthusiast planning your next big adventure -thepackmama.co is for you!

feeds.title: Drive on the Left Blog
feeds.description: We are Drew and Julie, serial American expats who made a new home for ourselves in London, and are now heading further afield to China! We use our little corner of the internet to inspire all travellers, armchair explorers, wanderlusters, and those whose travel itch needs a little scratching.

feeds.title: Lady & her Sweet Escapes
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Lady! I'm a Filipino Expat in Dubai, a full-time healthcare worker, an occasional traveler, a foodie at all times, a hopeless romantic living happily ever after.

feeds.title: The Expat Chronicle
feeds.description: I'm Lauren! Writer/Expat/Wife/Mom Blogging about Expat Life, Barcelona Tips, Travel Tales & Parenting Abroad. Tips & Tales from an American expat family living in Barcelona.

feeds.title: Tieland to Thailand Blog
feeds.description: Chris & Angela. #Thailand #Travel and Lifestyle Bloggers. Sharing destinations, food, and adventures throughout Thailand and around Southeast Asia.

feeds.title: thisgirlabroad
feeds.description: An expat in Hong Kong who loves to travel and eat. Preferably together. Here you'll find her worldwide travels, restaurant reviews based in Hong Kong, and day-to-day encounters as a former suburban girl now living in a concrete jungle.

feeds.title: Lamyerda
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Riz, currently an expat in Malaysia. I'm on a travel mission across the world without quitting my job! How will I do it? Join my journey as I explore each and every wonderful City, unravel history to reach my dream. Work. Family. Eat. Love. Travel. Repeat.

feeds.title: Expat Financial - Insurance for individual expatriates living abroad Blog
feeds.description: We provide global insurance plans for individual expatriates and global employers around much of the world. We can offer expats international health insurance plans from well known global insurance companies. Expat Financial also sources coverage for expatriate life and disability insurance and travel medical policies.

feeds.title: Future Expats Forum
feeds.description: I am Susanna Perkins. If you are Planning an international move, and supporting yourself once you get there are the biggest obstacles future expats face. Future Expats Forum provides the information you need.

feeds.title: Greenback Expat Tax Services Blog
feeds.description: Greenback's expatriate tax accountants have developed this library of info to provide you with important US expat tax advice and insight. Expert US Expat Tax Preparation. Simplified. Resolved. Designed to save you time and money.

feeds.title: Moovaz Blog
feeds.description: Moovaz is an all-encompassing relocation service built for the modern world, with a proven record of making relocation seamless and fuss-free for clients globally. We are committed to deliver convenience and service excellence, first time, every time.

feeds.title: Karen Roldan Blog
feeds.description: Karen shares her adventures and experiences (even the negative ones) while living abroad. A travel & expat life blog about a Filipino who moved to Sweden.

feeds.title: Little Miss Honey
feeds.description: A Lifestyle Blog of a Filipina in Singapore inspiring urban striving women to explore life's surprises through food, travel, books and family.

feeds.title: Dubai Expat Blog
feeds.description: Dubai Expat Blog covers an expat's perspective of living in Dubai, Business in Dubai, shopping, eating out, education, health, and transport in Dubai. We get you an expat Perspective on Dubai and UAE.

feeds.title: Amy and the Great World
feeds.description: Welcome to Amy and the Great World! I'm Amy, the girl behind the blog. I have taught English and traveled as much as possible for the past few years, and I'm currently teaching first grade in Budapest, Hungary. At Amy and the Great World, I strive to provide travel tips, photos that will inspire wanderlust, and a snapshot into my life as an expat.

feeds.title: Third Culture Professionals
feeds.description: Third Culture Professionals is a job search blog for the Expat Accompanying Partner who wants to return to work after a career break. It offers free practical job hunting and interview advice, motivation and tips from other Expat Partners and Experts. Founder Brid Doherty-Appriou has lived and worked globally as an Accompanying Partner, Expat and Executive Search Consultant.

feeds.title: Czech Off the Beaten Path
feeds.description: Welcome to Czech Off the Beaten Path. I am an American expat living in Czech Republic, I'm a freelance editor and writer, sharing info about the Czech Republic and experiences about expat life.

feeds.title: Gracefully Expat - Becoming location independent with intention Blog
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Grace, and I'm a serial expat. I'm a Canadian living in Dublin, and I also work in expat tax, so I live and breathe global mobility on a daily basis. I want to help other globally mobile people optimize their experience and live freer, more productive, and more creative lives. One of the ways we can do that is to talk about our experiences and share our knowledge.

feeds.title: Bright Lights of America - Insights from an Aussie expat
feeds.description: My name is Katherine and I am an Aussie living as an expat for the second time, in San Francisco.
